teaser: Six setups of an agentic system, from a task to conductors of conductors, with the altitudes of a run inside each: make the dangerous thing unreachable.
core_idea: An agentic system can be six setups: a task, one agent, an agent with sub-agents in one runtime, several sessions, a conductor and its team, and conductors of conductors. Inside each are the altitudes of a run (person, swarm, agent, loop, LLM call, code); the danger is the same privileges at every altitude and the control is reach. Higher setups need more command and control.

quotes.text: don't hope the agent behaves, make the dangerous thing unreachable
So the control is not good behaviour; it is reach.
The first three are a prompt, or a prompt and a project.
